problem_statement: When the nanocoap_token_ext module is enabled, nanocoap must support RFC 8974 extended CoAP token lengths. coap_build_hdr() must encode a token longer than 12 bytes using TKL 13 and one extra token-length byte before the token, returning a size that includes that byte; a token longer than 268 bytes must use TKL 14 and two extra bytes before the token, returning a size that includes them. coap_parse() must accept such headers and reject TKL 15 as a format error. For an accepted extended header, coap_get_token_len() must return the full token length and coap_get_token() must return a pointer to the token after the header and the extra byte(s), so the token contents and payload length are correct. Token lengths 0-12 must keep the existing non-extended behaviour.

verification.reason: The problem statement comprehensively describes all behaviors the hidden tests check: TKL 13/14 encoding with extra bytes in coap_build_hdr, acceptance and TKL 15 rejection in coap_parse, full-length return from coap_get_token_len, correct pointer from coap_get_token, and preservation of existing behavior for token lengths 0-12. All names used by the tests (nanocoap_token_ext, coap_build_hdr, coap_parse, coap_get_token_len, coap_get_token, TKL values) are either stated or existing repository APIs.
